The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

Under Section 6(1) of the Land Development Ordinance, Mr. Agam Podige Rohan Ranjith is appointed as a Land Officer for Southern Province with effect from 10.05.2019 in addition to the duties of his post. This appointment will be in effect until he serves in the said post and if he had been previously appointed as a Land Officer for another province or district/s, it shall be thereby cancelled.
K.D. Bandula Jayasinghe, Land Commissioner General, Land Commissioner General's Department.
Land Commissioner General's Department,“Mihikatha Medura”, 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,29th July, 2024.
